description:
Create a new user account for a recently hired physician in HospitalRun. Logged in as the system administrator, navigate to the Administration section (gear icon or sidebar) and access the Users management area. Create a new user with the following details:
- Display Name: 'Maria Santos'
- Email: 'maria.santos@hospital.org'
- Role: 'Doctor'

Save the new user account. Ensure the user appears in the user list.
